description: This file defines a grain class for Orleans, including its state class, with methods to get runtime ID and set/get a value.

classes.name: MultifacetTestGrainState
classes.description: Serializable class representing the state of the grain, containing an integer value.

classes.name: MultifacetTestGrain
classes.description: Grain class implementing IMultifacetTestGrain, with storage provider and methods to interact with grain state.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime identity of the grain instance.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets the value in the grain's state.

methods.name: IMultifacetReader.GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value from the grain's state.
